name: nvbit
role: NVIDIA's binary instrumentation library, the runtime the warp tracer (tools/nvbit/warp_trace) is built against and injected with; it records every dynamic instruction of one CTA's warps from the installed binary, unmodified
injection: CUDA_INJECTION64_PATH, the driver's injection variable: LD_PRELOAD loads the tool into a torch process and sees none of its launches (measured 2026-09-19)
why_not_gated_like_ptxas: the tracer never changes what the kernel computes or which binary runs; it reads the instruction stream of the ratified binary. What it must never be read for is TIME: an instrumented launch is ~1000x slower, so its polls, waits and fill timing are its own. Cycles come from the kernel's stamps (tools/phase_trace.py), instruction content from the trace.
